sources.entry: scrapy - A fast high-level web crawling and scraping framework.

summary.one_liner: Scrapy is a Python web scraping framework for extracting structured data from websites, maintained by Zyte and other contributors.
summary.what_it_does: Scrapy is a web scraping framework for extracting structured data from websites. The README describes it as cross-platform and requiring Python 3.11+. It is installable from PyPI with pip. The README points to external documentation for usage and to a contributing guide for contributors. It is maintained by Zyte (formerly Scrapinghub) together with other contributors. The README itself is brief and does not list specific features beyond this description.
use_cases: automate data collection from web pages
notable: Maintained by Zyte (formerly Scrapinghub) with many contributors
Listed under Web Scraping in vinta/awesome-python
caveats: README gives little detail; full usage is in external documentation
